headline: Graphic Designer
tagline: Graphic Designer with expertise in branding, marketing collateral, and reusable visual systems.

skills.label: Design & Branding
skills.items: Illustrator, Photoshop, CorelDRAW, Figma, branding and visual identity, typography, layout

skills.label: Production & Workflow
skills.items: print production, print-ready file management, design systems, AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly)

experience.title: Graphic Designer
bullets: Produced 100+ digital and print creatives spanning employee engagement, branding, recruitment, onboarding, and corporate communications.
Built reusable design templates and visual systems that cut turnaround time and repetitive work.
Designed banners, standees, certificates, ID cards, presentations, and marketing collateral.
Worked with HR and management stakeholders, maintaining low revision cycles.
Applied typography, colour systems, layout, visual hierarchy, and managed print-ready files including bleed, sizing, and colour accuracy.
Used AI-assisted workflows (ChatGPT, Adobe Firefly) for ideation and exploration.

experience.title: UI/UX Designer
bullets: Designed logos, visual identity systems, and brand guidelines for early-stage businesses.
Created social campaigns, branding assets, and brochures for startups and SMBs.
Used Photoshop and Illustrator for product visuals and marketing assets.
Conducted usability testing, feeding findings back into user flows and interface usability.
Created wireframes and prototypes, and worked with developers and stakeholders on design-to-development handoff.

projects.name: Social Campaign for a Fashion Brand
bullets: Executed an Instagram and Facebook series that achieved a 15% increase in follower engagement.

projects.name: Branding Kit for AT Creation Startup
bullets: Developed logo, typography, and palette for brand identity.

education.institution: RGCERT Chandrapur (Dr. Babasaheb Ambedkar Technological University)

emphasis: Led with her current agency role at Ascent Business Solutions, emphasizing high-volume creative production, branding, and template systems that match Advision's focus on marketing and visual identity.
omitted: Bounceless UX case study — stretch for a purely graphic design role, as it focuses on B2B product UX rather than marketing collateral.
